criteria.evidence: The Velveteen mount tests exercise the catalog, protected MCP endpoint, metadata and issuer routes under a base path. The original page and unrelated well-known route still respond, and startup and shutdown each occur once.
Both pinned protocols return the required scope descriptions. The tests distinguish insufficient grantable scope from permanent policy denial and count zero tool calls in every denied case.

The read and editor roles exercise lookup and rename through public and internal requests with hosted and external issuers. The external profile advertises its configured authority and leaves built-in consent routes unmounted.
